name: DownRight Fierce
source:
The slice-of-life shenanigans of visual novels like Butterfly Soup and Doki Doki Literature Club meet the quirky, power-infused worlds of fighting games like Street Fighter and Rival Schools in this character driven visual novel. 

Designed to feel like the fully fleshed out backstory of a small fighting game roster, DownRight Fierce will have players riding shotgun with protagonist Nishiko Shimomura as they are shipped off to a private school after acting out one too many times by abusing their latent Street Fighter -esque powers. Nishiko will have to navigate relationships in Windy Pines Academy, a strict boarding school designed to train those who are able to wield Ki-Flow, the ability to manifest one's own soul and spirit energy into physical form.

[From [url=https://destiny-smasher.itch.io/downright-fierce]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在这部由角色驱动的视觉小说中，《蝴蝶汤》和《心跳文学社》等视觉小说中的生活恶作剧与《街头霸王》和《Rival Schools》等格斗游戏中古怪、充满力量的世界相遇。

《DownRight Fierce》的设计感觉像是一个小型格斗游戏名单的充实的背景故事，玩家将与主角下村锦子一起骑着猎枪，因为他们因滥用潜在的街头霸王式的力量而多次表现出来，被送往一所私立学校。西子必须在风松学院处理人际关系，这是一所严格的寄宿学校，旨在训练那些能够运用Ki-Flow的人，Ki-Flow是一种将自己的灵魂和精神能量显化为物质形态的能力。

[来自[url=https://destiny-smasher.itch.io/downright-fierce]Itch.io[/url]]
